device.name: Pixel_6_API_30
device.devClientOverlay: floating gear at top-right, not product UI; it overlaps the header check/+ button

steps.observed: No environments connected; Add environment primary button; Chats/Pulls/Usage/Settings bottom tabs.
Tapping the T3 Code title with zero connections does not open a Connections screen; the screen is byte-identical to home-empty.
Full-screen Add environment page: scan card with outlined QR frame and 'Tap to scan', 'Or enter it', Address/Code card, footnote. Header check disabled while fields are empty.
Invalid host 127.0.0.1:1 produced a real transport failure shown in red below the card; the card border turns red and the page stays open.
System camera permission dialog: While using the app / Only this time / Deny.
Deny returns to the form with no error banner; entered fields remain.
Second scan attempt in the same session still shows the system permission dialog.
Back from Add environment returns to the Settings root (opener), not Home, because this entry is opened from Settings > Environments.
After a second denial, scan shows app dialog 'Camera access needed' with Cancel / Open Settings.
Real OAuth pairing against the isolated 0.1.9 server succeeded and returned to the opener (Settings root).
One environment row: desktop icon, host name, http://10.0.2.2:47861/, Connected, Desktop; enable switch; PR routing section with Off.
With a connected environment that reports no projects: 'No projects found' empty state and New thread primary action.
Tapping the title while connected and idle also does not open a Connections screen; identical to the previous screenshot.
Dark appearance of the connected no-projects home and bottom tabs.
Dark appearance of the connected environment row and PR routing section.
Dark appearance of the Add environment page; same structure as light.
Submitting to a black-holed address replaced the header check with a spinner while the request was in flight.
The black-holed address produced a real transport failure with the same red error treatment.
After granting camera permission the scan card becomes an active black preview with the scan control disabled; the emulator's synthetic camera supplies no readable QR.
Manage opens connection details: version 0.1.9, Routes, Your permissions, Edit, Connected/Desktop.
Edit reveals route removal and reorder controls; no environment-level remove action was found in this sheet.
After stopping only the isolated 47861 service, the original environment row switches to 'did not answer, Retrying' and keeps the saved address; existing 3773 remained listening.

notExecuted.reason: The headless Pixel_6_API_30 AVD uses hw.camera.back=emulated; its synthetic camera feed cannot present a QR, so camera recognition cannot be exercised on this device.
notExecuted.substituteRejected: No Replay, source, Harmony screenshot or browser preview was used for this case.

conclusion: B01 native visual and interaction evidence for the original app was obtained on the Android emulator: empty, add, submit connecting/failure, camera permission/denial/recovery, real pairing success back to opener, connected environment and dark appearance. Physical/synthetic QR recognition remains unavailable on this AVD.
